name: severe combined immunodeficiency due to IKK2 deficiency
description: Severe combined immunodeficiency due to IKK2 deficiency is a rare, genetic form of primary immunodeficiency characterized by life-threatening bacterial, fungal and viral infections with the onset in infancy, and failure to thrive. Typically, hypogammaglobulinemia or agammaglobulinemia and normal levels of T and B cells are present.
